discription: A warm, evolving pad sound using detuned sawtooth oscillators and a low-pass filter with a slow envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, attack=2, decay=3, sustain=0.7, release=4, cutoff=2000, rq=0.5, detune=1.005;var sig, env, lfo;env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);sig = Saw.ar(freq) + Saw.ar(freq * detune);lfo = SinOsc.kr(0.1).range(0.2, 0.8);sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff * lfo, rq);sig = sig * amp * env;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
